"""Transit search pipeline: detrend -> iterative BLS -> per-signal diagnostics."""
import sys, json
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from astropy.timeseries import BoxLeastSquares
from scipy.ndimage import median_filter

def load(star):
    d = pd.read_csv(f"data/{star}.csv")
    d = d[np.isfinite(d.flux)].sort_values("time_days").reset_index(drop=True)
    return d

def running_median_detrend(t, f, seg, window=0.75):
    """Time-windowed robust (iterative, clipped) median trend computed per segment
    and per contiguous chunk (gaps > 0.5 d split chunks)."""
    trend = np.full_like(f, np.nan)
    # chunk boundaries
    brk = np.where((np.diff(t) > 0.5) | (np.diff(seg) != 0))[0] + 1
    for idx in np.split(np.arange(len(t)), brk):
        tt, ff = t[idx], f[idx]
        mask = np.ones(len(tt), bool)
        for _ in range(3):
            tr = np.empty(len(tt))
            lo = np.searchsorted(tt, tt - window / 2)
            hi = np.searchsorted(tt, tt + window / 2)
            good_cum = None
            for i in range(len(tt)):
                w = ff[lo[i]:hi[i]][mask[lo[i]:hi[i]]]
                tr[i] = np.median(w) if len(w) > 5 else np.median(ff[lo[i]:hi[i]])
            r = ff - tr
            mad = 1.4826 * np.median(np.abs(r[mask] - np.median(r[mask])))
            mask = np.abs(r) < 3 * mad
        trend[idx] = tr
    return trend

def detrend(d, window=0.75):
    t, f, seg = d.time_days.values, d.flux.values, d.segment.values
    tr = running_median_detrend(t, f, seg, window)
    return f / tr

def bls_search(t, f, e, pmin=0.3, pmax=None, durations=None, mask=None):
    if mask is None: mask = np.ones(len(t), bool)
    t, f, e = t[mask], f[mask], e[mask]
    base = t.max() - t.min()
    if pmax is None: pmax = min(base / 2, 40)
    if durations is None:
        durations = np.array([0.5, 0.75, 1, 1.5, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8]) / 24
    bls = BoxLeastSquares(t, f, e)
    # frequency grid uniform in 1/P with oversampling based on duration
    q = durations.min()
    df = q / base**2 / 3
    freqs = np.arange(1 / pmax, 1 / pmin, df)
    if len(freqs) > 3_000_000:
        freqs = np.linspace(1 / pmax, 1 / pmin, 3_000_000)
    periods = np.sort(1 / freqs)
    res = bls.power(periods, durations, objective="snr")
    return bls, res

if __name__ == "__main__":
    pass

def bin_lc(t, f, width):
    """Bin to `width` days (only bins with data)."""
    k = np.floor((t - t.min()) / width).astype(int)
    u, inv, cnt = np.unique(k, return_inverse=True, return_counts=True)
    tb = np.bincount(inv, t) / cnt
    fb = np.bincount(inv, f) / cnt
    return tb, fb, cnt

def log_grid(T, pmin, pmax, dmin, os=3):
    dlnf = dmin / (T * os)
    return np.exp(np.arange(np.log(1 / pmax), np.log(1 / pmin), dlnf))

def search(t, f, pmin=0.25, pmax=None, os=3, durations=None, binw=10/1440):
    base = t.max() - t.min()
    if pmax is None: pmax = min(base / 2.0, 100)
    if durations is None:
        durations = np.array([0.5, 0.75, 1, 1.5, 2, 2.5, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 10]) / 24
    tb, fb, cnt = bin_lc(t, f, binw)
    sig = 1.4826 * np.median(np.abs(np.diff(f))) / np.sqrt(2)
    eb = sig / np.sqrt(cnt)
    freqs = log_grid(base, pmin, pmax, 1.0 / 24, os)
    periods = np.sort(1 / freqs)
    bls = BoxLeastSquares(tb, fb, eb)
    res = bls.power(periods, durations, objective="likelihood")
    return bls, res, (tb, fb, eb)

import sys, json, time, numpy as np, pandas as pd
from pipeline import search
SP = "/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-me-Documents-Projects-tess-runs-s2/a5ecfece-a5c3-45a7-bc95-d876c2a1eea7/scratchpad/"
def run(star, nmax=4, snr_min=7, extra_mask=None):
    d = pd.read_csv(SP + f"{star}_dt.csv")
    t, f = d.time_days.values, d.fdt.values
    r = f - 1; mad = 1.4826 * np.median(np.abs(r - np.median(r)))
    good = np.isfinite(f) & (r < 4 * mad)          # clip flares / upward outliers
    if extra_mask is not None: good &= extra_mask(t)
    out = []
    for it in range(nmax):
        t0c = time.time()
        bls, res, (tb, fb, eb) = search(t[good], f[good])
        i = np.argmax(res.power)
        P, T0, D, dep = res.period[i], res.transit_time[i], res.duration[i], res.depth[i]
        st = bls.compute_stats(P, D, T0)
        intr = bls.transit_mask(t, P, D, T0)
        # SNR from unbinned data
        n_in = (intr & good).sum()
        snr = dep / mad * np.sqrt(max(n_in, 1))
        # SDE
        p = res.power; sde = (p[i] - np.median(p)) / np.std(p)
        rec = dict(P=P, T0=T0, D_h=D*24, depth_ppm=dep*1e6, snr=snr, sde=sde, n_in=int(n_in),
                   odd=st["depth_odd"][0]*1e6, odd_e=st["depth_odd"][1]*1e6,
                   even=st["depth_even"][0]*1e6, even_e=st["depth_even"][1]*1e6,
                   half=st["depth_half"][0]*1e6, half_e=st["depth_half"][1]*1e6,
                   phased=st["depth_phased"][0]*1e6, phased_e=st["depth_phased"][1]*1e6,
                   ntr=int(np.sum(st["per_transit_count"] > 0)),
                   t_s=round(time.time() - t0c, 1))
        print(star, it, {k: (round(v, 4) if isinstance(v, float) else v) for k, v in rec.items()}, flush=True)
        out.append(rec)
        good &= ~bls.transit_mask(t, P, 2.0 * D, T0)
        if snr < snr_min: break
    return out
if __name__ == "__main__":
    allr = {}
    for s in sys.argv[1:]:
        allr[s] = run(s)
        json.dump(allr[s], open(SP + f"{s}_bls.json", "w"), default=float)

        if snr < snr_min: break""","""        good &= ~(np.abs((t - T0 + 0.5*P) % P - 0.5*P) < D)
        if rec['snr_red'] < snr_min or sde < 7: break""")
s=s.replace("""        # SDE""","""        # red-noise-aware SNR: scatter of out-of-transit flux binned on duration D
        oot = good & ~intr
        tb2 = np.floor((t[oot]-t[oot].min())/D).astype(int)
        u, inv, c = np.unique(tb2, return_inverse=True, return_counts=True)
        fbin = np.bincount(inv, f[oot]-1)/c
        ok = c > 0.6*np.median(c)
        sigD = 1.4826*np.median(np.abs(fbin[ok]-np.median(fbin[ok])))
        ntr_eff = n_in / np.median(c)
        snr_red = dep / sigD * np.sqrt(ntr_eff)
        # SDE""")
s=s.replace("rec = dict(P=P,","rec = dict(snr_red=snr_red, P=P,")
open('run_search.py','w').write(s)

"""Transit search pipeline: detrend -> quality mask -> iterative BLS -> diagnostics.

Run:  ../.venv/bin/python pipeline.py star_01 [star_02 ...]
"""
import sys, json, os
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from astropy.timeseries import BoxLeastSquares

OUT = os.environ.get("TESS_OUT", "work")

# Detrending window (days) per star; default 0.75 d.  Star 06 is a fast, high-amplitude
# spotted rotator, so it gets a shorter window.
WINDOW = {"star_06": 0.3}

# Time ranges removed by hand after visual inspection (instrumental ramps the
# running median cannot follow).  Everything else is handled automatically.
MANUAL_BAD = {
    "star_03": [(95.3, 97.8), (209.8, 211.8)],
}


def load(star):
    d = pd.read_csv(f"data/{star}.csv")
    d = d[np.isfinite(d.flux) & np.isfinite(d.time_days)]
    return d.sort_values("time_days").reset_index(drop=True)


def chunks(t, seg, gap=0.5):
    brk = np.where((np.diff(t) > gap) | (np.diff(seg) != 0))[0] + 1
    return np.split(np.arange(len(t)), brk)


def robust_std(x):
    x = x[np.isfinite(x)]
    return 1.4826 * np.median(np.abs(x - np.median(x)))


def running_median_trend(t, f, seg, window):
    """Iteratively sigma-clipped running median in a time window, per contiguous chunk.
    Clipping (3 sigma, both sides) keeps transits from dragging the trend down."""
    trend = np.full_like(f, np.nan)
    for idx in chunks(t, seg):
        tt, ff = t[idx], f[idx]
        lo = np.searchsorted(tt, tt - window / 2)
        hi = np.searchsorted(tt, tt + window / 2)
        mask = np.ones(len(tt), bool)
        for _ in range(3):
            tr = np.empty(len(tt))
            for i in range(len(tt)):
                w = ff[lo[i]:hi[i]][mask[lo[i]:hi[i]]]
                tr[i] = np.median(w) if len(w) > 5 else np.median(ff[lo[i]:hi[i]])
            r = ff - tr
            mask = np.abs(r) < 3 * robust_std(r[mask])
        trend[idx] = tr
    return trend


def quality_mask(t, f, seg, star):
    """True = keep.  Removes upward outliers (flares, >4 sigma), time windows where the
    local scatter is > 3x typical (pointing jitter / scattered light), and manual windows."""
    r = f - 1
    sig = robust_std(r)
    good = np.isfinite(f) & (r < 4 * sig)
    # local scatter on 0.25-d windows, using point-to-point differences (insensitive to transits)
    loc = np.zeros(len(t))
    for idx in chunks(t, seg):
        tt = t[idx]
        dd = np.abs(np.diff(f[idx], prepend=f[idx][0]))
        lo = np.searchsorted(tt, tt - 0.125); hi = np.searchsorted(tt, tt + 0.125)
        cs = np.concatenate([[0], np.cumsum(dd)])
        loc[idx] = (cs[hi] - cs[lo]) / np.maximum(hi - lo, 1)
    typ = np.median(loc)
    bad = loc > 3 * typ
    # grow bad regions by 0.2 d
    if bad.any():
        tb = t[bad]
        j = np.searchsorted(tb, t)
        dist = np.minimum(np.abs(t - tb[np.clip(j - 1, 0, len(tb) - 1)]),
                          np.abs(t - tb[np.clip(j, 0, len(tb) - 1)]))
        good &= dist > 0.2
    for a, b in MANUAL_BAD.get(star, []):
        good &= ~((t > a) & (t < b))
    return good


def bin_lc(t, f, width):
    k = np.floor((t - t.min()) / width).astype(np.int64)
    u, inv, cnt = np.unique(k, return_inverse=True, return_counts=True)
    return np.bincount(inv, t) / cnt, np.bincount(inv, f) / cnt, cnt


DURS_H = np.array([0.33, 0.5, 0.75, 1, 1.25, 1.5, 2, 2.5, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 10, 13])


def bls_search(t, f, pmin=0.2, pmax=None, os=3, binw=5 / 1440):
    """BLS over a log-uniform frequency grid fine enough that a 1-h transit drifts by
    <1/os of its duration across the full baseline.  Each duration is searched separately
    and only durations with D <= 0.15 P (and D >= 0.01 P) are allowed at each period."""
    base = t.max() - t.min()
    if pmax is None:
        pmax = min(base / 2.0, 60.0)
    tb, fb, cnt = bin_lc(t, f, binw)
    sig = robust_std(np.diff(f)) / np.sqrt(2)
    eb = sig / np.sqrt(cnt)
    dlnf = (1.0 / 24) / (base * os)
    freqs = np.exp(np.arange(np.log(1 / pmax), np.log(1 / pmin), dlnf))
    periods = np.sort(1 / freqs)
    bls = BoxLeastSquares(tb, fb, eb)
    best = np.full(len(periods), -np.inf)
    arg = dict(t0=np.zeros(len(periods)), dur=np.zeros(len(periods)), depth=np.zeros(len(periods)))
    for dh in DURS_H:
        D = dh / 24
        ok = (D <= 0.15 * periods) & (D >= 0.01 * periods * 0 + 0.0)
        if not ok.any():
            continue
        r = bls.power(periods[ok], D, objective="likelihood")
        # likelihood = 0.5*chi2 improvement; convert to SNR-like quantity
        p = np.sqrt(np.maximum(2 * r.power, 0)) * np.sign(r.depth)
        sel = np.where(ok)[0]
        upd = p > best[sel]
        s2 = sel[upd]
        best[s2] = p[upd]
        arg["t0"][s2] = r.transit_time[upd]
        arg["dur"][s2] = D
        arg["depth"][s2] = r.depth[upd]
    return bls, periods, best, arg


def fold_phase(t, P, T0):
    return (t - T0 + 0.5 * P) % P - 0.5 * P  # days from transit centre


def signal_stats(t, f, P, T0, D, good):
    """Depth, red-noise-aware SNR, odd/even, secondary and per-transit diagnostics."""
    ph = fold_phase(t, P, T0)
    intr = np.abs(ph) < 0.5 * D
    near = np.abs(ph) < 1.5 * D
    oot = good & ~near
    epoch = np.round((t - T0) / P).astype(int)
    base = np.median(f[good & ~near & (np.abs(ph) < 3 * D + 0.2)]) if np.any(good & ~near & (np.abs(ph) < 3 * D + 0.2)) else 1.0
    def dep(m):
        m = m & good
        if m.sum() < 3:
            return np.nan, np.nan
        return base - np.mean(f[m]), robust_std(f[oot]) / np.sqrt(m.sum())
    depth, depth_e = dep(intr)
    # red noise: robust std of oot flux binned to duration D
    k = np.floor((t[oot] - t[oot].min()) / D).astype(np.int64)
    u, inv, c = np.unique(k, return_inverse=True, return_counts=True)
    fb = np.bincount(inv, f[oot]) / c
    okb = c > 0.6 * np.median(c)
    sigD = robust_std(fb[okb])
    n_in = (intr & good).sum()
    ntr_eff = n_in / np.median(c)
    snr = depth / sigD * np.sqrt(ntr_eff)
    odd, odd_e = dep(intr & (epoch % 2 == 1))
    even, even_e = dep(intr & (epoch % 2 == 0))
    ph2 = fold_phase(t, P, T0 + 0.5 * P)
    sec, sec_e = dep(np.abs(ph2) < 0.5 * D)
    # per-transit depths
    per = {}
    for e in np.unique(epoch[intr & good]):
        m = intr & good & (epoch == e)
        if m.sum() >= 3:
            per[int(e)] = float(base - np.mean(f[m]))
    return dict(depth=depth, depth_e=depth_e, snr=snr, sigD=sigD, n_in=int(n_in),
                ntr=len(per), odd=odd, odd_e=odd_e, even=even, even_e=even_e,
                sec=sec, sec_e=sec_e, per_transit=per)


def refine(t, f, good, P, T0, D):
    """Fine local BLS around the peak for better P, T0, D."""
    m = good
    bls = BoxLeastSquares(t[m], f[m])
    base = t[m].max() - t[m].min()
    dP = P * D / base
    periods = np.linspace(P - 3 * dP, P + 3 * dP, 301)
    durs = np.unique(np.clip(np.linspace(0.5 * D, 1.6 * D, 23), 0.2 / 24, 0.2 * P))
    r = bls.power(periods, durs, objective="likelihood", oversample=50)
    i = np.argmax(r.power)
    return r.period[i], r.transit_time[i], r.duration[i]


def run(star, nmax=6, snr_min=7.0, verbose=True):
    d = load(star)
    t, f, seg = d.time_days.values, d.flux.values, d.segment.values
    trend = running_median_trend(t, f, seg, WINDOW.get(star, 0.75))
    fd = f / trend
    good = quality_mask(t, fd, seg, star)
    os.makedirs(OUT, exist_ok=True)
    pd.DataFrame(dict(t=t, f=fd, raw=f, trend=trend, good=good, seg=seg)).to_csv(
        f"{OUT}/{star}_lc.csv", index=False)
    search_mask = good.copy()
    sigs = []
    for it in range(nmax):
        bls, periods, power, arg = bls_search(t[search_mask], fd[search_mask])
        i = np.argmax(power)
        sde = (power[i] - np.median(power)) / np.std(power)
        P, T0, D = periods[i], arg["t0"][i], arg["dur"][i]
        P, T0, D = refine(t, fd, search_mask, P, T0, D)
        st = signal_stats(t, fd, P, T0, D, search_mask)
        rec = dict(iter=it, P=P, T0=T0, D_h=D * 24, sde=sde, peak=power[i], **st)
        if verbose:
            print(star, it, "P=%.5f T0=%.4f D=%.2fh depth=%.0f snr=%.1f sde=%.1f ntr=%d odd=%.0f±%.0f even=%.0f±%.0f sec=%.0f±%.0f" % (
                P, T0, D * 24, st["depth"] * 1e6, st["snr"], sde, st["ntr"], st["odd"] * 1e6, st["odd_e"] * 1e6,
                st["even"] * 1e6, st["even_e"] * 1e6, st["sec"] * 1e6, st["sec_e"] * 1e6), flush=True)
        np.save(f"{OUT}/{star}_pgram{it}.npy", np.vstack([periods, power]))
        sigs.append(rec)
        if st["snr"] < snr_min or sde < 6:
            break
        search_mask &= ~(np.abs(fold_phase(t, P, T0)) < max(1.5 * D, D + 1 / 24))
    json.dump(sigs, open(f"{OUT}/{star}_signals.json", "w"), default=float, indent=1)
    return sigs


if __name__ == "__main__":
    for s in sys.argv[1:]:
        run(s)

OUT = os.environ.get("TESS_OUT", "work")

# Detrending window (days) per star; default 0.75 d.  Star 06 is a fast, high-amplitude
# spotted rotator, so it gets a shorter window.
WINDOW = {"star_06": 0.3}

# running median cannot follow).  Everything else is handled automatically.
MANUAL_BAD = {
    "star_03": [(95.3, 97.8), (209.8, 211.8)],
}

    d = pd.read_csv(f"data/{star}.csv")
    d = d[np.isfinite(d.flux) & np.isfinite(d.time_days)]
    return d.sort_values("time_days").reset_index(drop=True)


def chunks(t, seg, gap=0.5):
    brk = np.where((np.diff(t) > gap) | (np.diff(seg) != 0))[0] + 1
    return np.split(np.arange(len(t)), brk)


def robust_std(x):
    x = x[np.isfinite(x)]
    return 1.4826 * np.median(np.abs(x - np.median(x)))


def running_median_trend(t, f, seg, window):
    """Iteratively sigma-clipped running median in a time window, per contiguous chunk.
    Clipping (3 sigma, both sides) keeps transits from dragging the trend down."""
    trend = np.full_like(f, np.nan)
    for idx in chunks(t, seg):
        tt, ff = t[idx], f[idx]
        lo = np.searchsorted(tt, tt - window / 2)
        hi = np.searchsorted(tt, tt + window / 2)
        mask = np.ones(len(tt), bool)
        for _ in range(3):
            tr = np.empty(len(tt))
            for i in range(len(tt)):
                w = ff[lo[i]:hi[i]][mask[lo[i]:hi[i]]]
                tr[i] = np.median(w) if len(w) > 5 else np.median(ff[lo[i]:hi[i]])
            r = ff - tr
            mask = np.abs(r) < 3 * robust_std(r[mask])
        trend[idx] = tr
    return trend

    """True = keep.  Removes upward outliers (flares, >4 sigma), time windows where the
    local scatter is > 3x typical (pointing jitter / scattered light), and manual windows."""
    r = f - 1
    sig = robust_std(r)
    good = np.isfinite(f) & (r < 4 * sig)
    # local point-to-point scatter in 0.25-d windows (insensitive to transits)
    loc = np.zeros(len(t))
    for idx in chunks(t, seg):
        tt = t[idx]
        dd = np.abs(np.diff(f[idx], prepend=f[idx][0]))
        lo = np.searchsorted(tt, tt - 0.125); hi = np.searchsorted(tt, tt + 0.125)
        cs = np.concatenate([[0], np.cumsum(dd)])
        loc[idx] = (cs[hi] - cs[lo]) / np.maximum(hi - lo, 1)
        # normalise per chunk (cadence / noise level can differ between segments)
        loc[idx] /= np.median(loc[idx])
    bad = loc > 3
    if bad.any():  # grow bad regions by 0.2 d

        j = np.searchsorted(tb, t)
        dist = np.minimum(np.abs(t - tb[np.clip(j - 1, 0, len(tb) - 1)]),
                          np.abs(t - tb[np.clip(j, 0, len(tb) - 1)]))

    k = np.floor((t - t.min()) / width).astype(np.int64)
    u, inv, cnt = np.unique(k, return_inverse=True, return_counts=True)
    return np.bincount(inv, t) / cnt, np.bincount(inv, f) / cnt, cnt

    odd, odd_e = dep(intr & (epoch % 2 != 0))
    even, even_e = dep(intr & (epoch % 2 == 0))
    ph2 = fold_phase(t, P, T0 + 0.5 * P)
    sec, sec_e = dep(np.abs(ph2) < 0.5 * D)
    per = {}
    for e in np.unique(epoch[intr & good]):
        m = intr & good & (epoch == e)
        if m.sum() >= 0.5 * np.median(c):
            per[int(e)] = float(1.0 - np.mean(f[m]))
    return dict(depth=depth, depth_e=depth_e, snr=snr, sigD=sigD, n_in=int(n_in),
                ntr=len(per), odd=odd, odd_e=odd_e, even=even, even_e=even_e,
                sec=sec, sec_e=sec_e, per_transit=per)


def refine(t, f, good, P, T0, D):
    """Fine local BLS around the peak for better P, T0, D."""
    tt, ff = t[good], f[good]
    bls = BoxLeastSquares(tt, ff)
    base = tt.max() - tt.min()
    dP = P * D / base
    periods = np.linspace(P - 2 * dP, P + 2 * dP, 201)
    durs = np.unique(np.clip(np.linspace(0.5 * D, 1.6 * D, 23), 0.2 / 24, 0.2 * P))
    r = bls.power(periods, durs, objective="likelihood", oversample=30)
    i = np.argmax(r.power)
    T0 = r.transit_time[i]
    # put T0 near the middle of the data
    n = np.round((np.median(tt) - T0) / r.period[i])
    return r.period[i], T0, r.duration[i]


def run(star, nmax=6, snr_min=7.0, verbose=True):
    d = load(star)
    t, f, seg = d.time_days.values, d.flux.values, d.segment.values
    trend = running_median_trend(t, f, seg, WINDOW.get(star, 0.75))
    fd = f / trend
    good = quality_mask(t, fd, seg, star)
    os.makedirs(OUT, exist_ok=True)
    pd.DataFrame(dict(t=t, f=fd, raw=f, trend=trend, good=good, seg=seg)).to_csv(
        f"{OUT}/{star}_lc.csv", index=False)
    if verbose:
        print(star, "masked %.1f%% of points" % (100 * (1 - good.mean())), flush=True)
    search_mask = good.copy()
    sigs = []
    for it in range(nmax):
        periods, power, arg = bls_search(t[search_mask], fd[search_mask])
        i = np.argmax(power)
        sde = (power[i] - np.median(power)) / np.std(power)
        P, T0, D = periods[i], arg["t0"][i], arg["dur"][i]
        P, T0, D = refine(t, fd, search_mask, P, T0, D)
        st = signal_stats(t, fd, P, T0, D, search_mask)
        rec = dict(iter=it, P=P, T0=T0, D_h=D * 24, sde=sde, peak=power[i], **st)
        if verbose:
            print(star, it, "P=%.5f T0=%.4f D=%.2fh depth=%.0f snr=%.1f sde=%.1f ntr=%d odd=%.0f±%.0f even=%.0f±%.0f sec=%.0f±%.0f" % (
                P, T0, D * 24, st["depth"] * 1e6, st["snr"], sde, st["ntr"], st["odd"] * 1e6, st["odd_e"] * 1e6,
                st["even"] * 1e6, st["even_e"] * 1e6, st["sec"] * 1e6, st["sec_e"] * 1e6), flush=True)
        np.save(f"{OUT}/{star}_pgram{it}.npy", np.vstack([periods, power]))
        sigs.append(rec)
        if st["snr"] < snr_min or sde < 6:
            break
        search_mask &= ~(np.abs(fold_phase(t, P, T0)) < max(1.0 * D, 0.5 * D + 1 / 24))
    json.dump(sigs, open(f"{OUT}/{star}_signals.json", "w"), default=float, indent=1)
    return sigs


if __name__ == "__main__":
    for s in sys.argv[1:]:
        run(s)

"""Transit search pipeline: detrend -> quality mask -> iterative BLS -> diagnostics.

Run:  ../.venv/bin/python pipeline.py star_01 [star_02 ...]
"""
import sys, json, os
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from astropy.timeseries import BoxLeastSquares

OUT = os.environ.get("TESS_OUT", "work")

# Detrending window (days) per star; default 0.75 d.  Star 06 is a fast, high-amplitude
# spotted rotator, so it gets a shorter window.
WINDOW = {"star_06": 0.3}

# Time ranges removed by hand after visual inspection (instrumental ramps the
# running median cannot follow).  Everything else is handled automatically.
MANUAL_BAD = {
    "star_03": [(95.3, 97.8), (209.8, 211.8)],
}


def load(star):
    d = pd.read_csv(f"data/{star}.csv")
    d = d[np.isfinite(d.flux) & np.isfinite(d.time_days)]
    return d.sort_values("time_days").reset_index(drop=True)


def chunks(t, seg, gap=0.5):
    brk = np.where((np.diff(t) > gap) | (np.diff(seg) != 0))[0] + 1
    return np.split(np.arange(len(t)), brk)


def robust_std(x):
    x = x[np.isfinite(x)]
    return 1.4826 * np.median(np.abs(x - np.median(x)))


def running_median_trend(t, f, seg, window):
    """Iteratively sigma-clipped running median in a time window, per contiguous chunk.
    Clipping (3 sigma, both sides) keeps transits from dragging the trend down."""
    trend = np.full_like(f, np.nan)
    for idx in chunks(t, seg):
        tt, ff = t[idx], f[idx]
        lo = np.searchsorted(tt, tt - window / 2)
        hi = np.searchsorted(tt, tt + window / 2)
        mask = np.ones(len(tt), bool)
        for _ in range(3):
            tr = np.empty(len(tt))
            for i in range(len(tt)):
                w = ff[lo[i]:hi[i]][mask[lo[i]:hi[i]]]
                tr[i] = np.median(w) if len(w) > 5 else np.median(ff[lo[i]:hi[i]])
            r = ff - tr
            mask = np.abs(r) < 3 * robust_std(r[mask])
        trend[idx] = tr
    return trend


def quality_mask(t, f, seg, star):
    """True = keep.  Removes upward outliers (flares, >4 sigma), time windows where the
    local scatter is > 3x typical (pointing jitter / scattered light), and manual windows."""
    r = f - 1
    sig = robust_std(r)
    good = np.isfinite(f) & (r < 4 * sig)
    # local point-to-point scatter in 0.25-d windows (insensitive to transits)
    loc = np.zeros(len(t))
    for idx in chunks(t, seg):
        tt = t[idx]
        dd = np.abs(np.diff(f[idx], prepend=f[idx][0]))
        lo = np.searchsorted(tt, tt - 0.125); hi = np.searchsorted(tt, tt + 0.125)
        cs = np.concatenate([[0], np.cumsum(dd)])
        loc[idx] = (cs[hi] - cs[lo]) / np.maximum(hi - lo, 1)
        # normalise per chunk (cadence / noise level can differ between segments)
        loc[idx] /= np.median(loc[idx])
    bad = loc > 3
    if bad.any():  # grow bad regions by 0.2 d
        tb = t[bad]
        j = np.searchsorted(tb, t)
        dist = np.minimum(np.abs(t - tb[np.clip(j - 1, 0, len(tb) - 1)]),
                          np.abs(t - tb[np.clip(j, 0, len(tb) - 1)]))
        good &= dist > 0.2
    for a, b in MANUAL_BAD.get(star, []):
        good &= ~((t > a) & (t < b))
    return good


def bin_lc(t, f, width):
    k = np.floor((t - t.min()) / width).astype(np.int64)
    u, inv, cnt = np.unique(k, return_inverse=True, return_counts=True)
    return np.bincount(inv, t) / cnt, np.bincount(inv, f) / cnt, cnt


DURS_H = np.array([0.33, 0.5, 0.75, 1, 1.25, 1.5, 2, 2.5, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 10, 13])


def bls_search(t, f, pmin=0.2, pmax=None, os=3, binw=5 / 1440):
    """BLS over a log-uniform frequency grid fine enough that a 1-h transit drifts by
    <1/os of its duration across the full baseline.  Each duration is searched separately
    and only durations with D <= 0.15 P are allowed at each period."""
    base = t.max() - t.min()
    if pmax is None:
        pmax = min(base / 2.0, 60.0)
    tb, fb, cnt = bin_lc(t, f, binw)
    sig = robust_std(np.diff(f)) / np.sqrt(2)
    eb = sig / np.sqrt(cnt)
    dlnf = (1.0 / 24) / (base * os)
    freqs = np.exp(np.arange(np.log(1 / pmax), np.log(1 / pmin), dlnf))
    periods = np.sort(1 / freqs)
    bls = BoxLeastSquares(tb, fb, eb)
    best = np.full(len(periods), -np.inf)
    arg = dict(t0=np.zeros(len(periods)), dur=np.zeros(len(periods)), depth=np.zeros(len(periods)))
    for dh in DURS_H:
        D = dh / 24
        ok = D <= 0.15 * periods
        if not ok.any():
            continue
        r = bls.power(periods[ok], D, objective="likelihood")
        p = np.sqrt(np.maximum(2 * r.power, 0)) * np.sign(r.depth)  # ~ white-noise SNR
        sel = np.where(ok)[0]
        upd = p > best[sel]
        s2 = sel[upd]
        best[s2] = p[upd]
        arg["t0"][s2] = r.transit_time[upd]
        arg["dur"][s2] = D
        arg["depth"][s2] = r.depth[upd]
    return periods, best, arg


def fold_phase(t, P, T0):
    return (t - T0 + 0.5 * P) % P - 0.5 * P  # days from transit centre


def signal_stats(t, f, P, T0, D, good):
    """Depth, red-noise-aware SNR, odd/even, secondary and per-transit depths."""
    ph = fold_phase(t, P, T0)
    intr = np.abs(ph) < 0.5 * D
    near = np.abs(ph) < 1.0 * D
    oot = good & ~near
    epoch = np.round((t - T0) / P).astype(int)
    sig1 = robust_std(f[oot])

    def dep(m):
        m = m & good
        if m.sum() < 3:
            return np.nan, np.nan
        return 1.0 - np.mean(f[m]), sig1 / np.sqrt(m.sum())
    depth, depth_e = dep(intr)
    # red noise: robust std of out-of-transit flux binned to duration D
    k = np.floor((t[oot] - t[oot].min()) / D).astype(np.int64)
    u, inv, c = np.unique(k, return_inverse=True, return_counts=True)
    fb = np.bincount(inv, f[oot]) / c
    okb = c > 0.6 * np.median(c)
    sigD = robust_std(fb[okb])
    n_in = (intr & good).sum()
    ntr_eff = n_in / np.median(c)
    snr = depth / sigD * np.sqrt(ntr_eff)
    odd, odd_e = dep(intr & (epoch % 2 != 0))
    even, even_e = dep(intr & (epoch % 2 == 0))
    ph2 = fold_phase(t, P, T0 + 0.5 * P)
    sec, sec_e = dep(np.abs(ph2) < 0.5 * D)
    per = {}
    for e in np.unique(epoch[intr & good]):
        m = intr & good & (epoch == e)
        if m.sum() >= 0.5 * np.median(c):
            per[int(e)] = float(1.0 - np.mean(f[m]))
    return dict(depth=depth, depth_e=depth_e, snr=snr, sigD=sigD, n_in=int(n_in),
                ntr=len(per), odd=odd, odd_e=odd_e, even=even, even_e=even_e,
                sec=sec, sec_e=sec_e, per_transit=per)


def refine(t, f, good, P, T0, D):
    """Fine local BLS around the peak for better P, T0, D."""
    tt, ff = t[good], f[good]
    bls = BoxLeastSquares(tt, ff)
    base = tt.max() - tt.min()
    dP = P * D / base
    periods = np.linspace(P - 2 * dP, P + 2 * dP, 201)
    durs = np.unique(np.clip(np.linspace(0.5 * D, 1.6 * D, 23), 0.2 / 24, 0.2 * P))
    r = bls.power(periods, durs, objective="likelihood", oversample=30)
    i = np.argmax(r.power)
    T0 = r.transit_time[i]
    # put T0 near the middle of the data
    n = np.round((np.median(tt) - T0) / r.period[i])
    return r.period[i], T0, r.duration[i]


def run(star, nmax=6, snr_min=7.0, verbose=True):
    d = load(star)
    t, f, seg = d.time_days.values, d.flux.values, d.segment.values
    trend = running_median_trend(t, f, seg, WINDOW.get(star, 0.75))
    fd = f / trend
    good = quality_mask(t, fd, seg, star)
    os.makedirs(OUT, exist_ok=True)
    pd.DataFrame(dict(t=t, f=fd, raw=f, trend=trend, good=good, seg=seg)).to_csv(
        f"{OUT}/{star}_lc.csv", index=False)
    if verbose:
        print(star, "masked %.1f%% of points" % (100 * (1 - good.mean())), flush=True)
    search_mask = good.copy()
    sigs = []
    for it in range(nmax):
        periods, power, arg = bls_search(t[search_mask], fd[search_mask])
        i = np.argmax(power)
        sde = (power[i] - np.median(power)) / np.std(power)
        P, T0, D = periods[i], arg["t0"][i], arg["dur"][i]
        P, T0, D = refine(t, fd, search_mask, P, T0, D)
        st = signal_stats(t, fd, P, T0, D, search_mask)
        rec = dict(iter=it, P=P, T0=T0, D_h=D * 24, sde=sde, peak=power[i], **st)
        if verbose:
            print(star, it, "P=%.5f T0=%.4f D=%.2fh depth=%.0f snr=%.1f sde=%.1f ntr=%d odd=%.0f±%.0f even=%.0f±%.0f sec=%.0f±%.0f" % (
                P, T0, D * 24, st["depth"] * 1e6, st["snr"], sde, st["ntr"], st["odd"] * 1e6, st["odd_e"] * 1e6,
                st["even"] * 1e6, st["even_e"] * 1e6, st["sec"] * 1e6, st["sec_e"] * 1e6), flush=True)
        np.save(f"{OUT}/{star}_pgram{it}.npy", np.vstack([periods, power]))
        sigs.append(rec)
        if st["snr"] < snr_min or sde < 6:
            break
        search_mask &= ~(np.abs(fold_phase(t, P, T0)) < max(1.0 * D, 0.5 * D + 1 / 24))
    json.dump(sigs, open(f"{OUT}/{star}_signals.json", "w"), default=float, indent=1)
    return sigs

    for s in sys.argv[1:]:
        run(s)

"""Transit search pipeline: detrend -> iterative BLS -> per-signal diagnostics."""
import sys, json
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from astropy.timeseries import BoxLeastSquares
from scipy.ndimage import median_filter

def load(star):
    d = pd.read_csv(f"data/{star}.csv")
    d = d[np.isfinite(d.flux)].sort_values("time_days").reset_index(drop=True)
    return d

def running_median_detrend(t, f, seg, window=0.75):
    """Time-windowed robust (iterative, clipped) median trend computed per segment
    and per contiguous chunk (gaps > 0.5 d split chunks)."""
    trend = np.full_like(f, np.nan)
    # chunk boundaries
    brk = np.where((np.diff(t) > 0.5) | (np.diff(seg) != 0))[0] + 1
    for idx in np.split(np.arange(len(t)), brk):
        tt, ff = t[idx], f[idx]
        mask = np.ones(len(tt), bool)
        for _ in range(3):
            tr = np.empty(len(tt))
            lo = np.searchsorted(tt, tt - window / 2)
            hi = np.searchsorted(tt, tt + window / 2)
            good_cum = None
            for i in range(len(tt)):
                w = ff[lo[i]:hi[i]][mask[lo[i]:hi[i]]]
                tr[i] = np.median(w) if len(w) > 5 else np.median(ff[lo[i]:hi[i]])
            r = ff - tr
            mad = 1.4826 * np.median(np.abs(r[mask] - np.median(r[mask])))
            mask = np.abs(r) < 3 * mad
        trend[idx] = tr
    return trend

def detrend(d, window=0.75):
    t, f, seg = d.time_days.values, d.flux.values, d.segment.values
    tr = running_median_detrend(t, f, seg, window)
    return f / tr

def bls_search(t, f, e, pmin=0.3, pmax=None, durations=None, mask=None):
    if mask is None: mask = np.ones(len(t), bool)
    t, f, e = t[mask], f[mask], e[mask]
    base = t.max() - t.min()
    if pmax is None: pmax = min(base / 2, 40)
    if durations is None:
        durations = np.array([0.5, 0.75, 1, 1.5, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8]) / 24
    bls = BoxLeastSquares(t, f, e)
    # frequency grid uniform in 1/P with oversampling based on duration
    q = durations.min()
    df = q / base**2 / 3
    freqs = np.arange(1 / pmax, 1 / pmin, df)
    if len(freqs) > 3_000_000:
        freqs = np.linspace(1 / pmax, 1 / pmin, 3_000_000)
    periods = np.sort(1 / freqs)
    res = bls.power(periods, durations, objective="snr")
    return bls, res

if __name__ == "__main__":
    pass

def bin_lc(t, f, width):
    """Bin to `width` days (only bins with data)."""
    k = np.floor((t - t.min()) / width).astype(int)
    u, inv, cnt = np.unique(k, return_inverse=True, return_counts=True)
    tb = np.bincount(inv, t) / cnt
    fb = np.bincount(inv, f) / cnt
    return tb, fb, cnt

def log_grid(T, pmin, pmax, dmin, os=3):
    dlnf = dmin / (T * os)
    return np.exp(np.arange(np.log(1 / pmax), np.log(1 / pmin), dlnf))

def search(t, f, pmin=0.45, pmax=None, os=3, durations=None, binw=10/1440):
    base = t.max() - t.min()
    if pmax is None: pmax = min(base / 2.0, 100)
    if durations is None:
        durations = np.array([0.5, 0.75, 1, 1.5, 2, 2.5, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 10]) / 24
    tb, fb, cnt = bin_lc(t, f, binw)
    sig = 1.4826 * np.median(np.abs(np.diff(f))) / np.sqrt(2)
    eb = sig / np.sqrt(cnt)
    freqs = log_grid(base, pmin, pmax, 1.0 / 24, os)
    periods = np.sort(1 / freqs)
    bls = BoxLeastSquares(tb, fb, eb)
    res = bls.power(periods, durations, objective="likelihood")
    return bls, res, (tb, fb, eb)

    ax1.plot(ph[m], (f[m] - 1) * 1e6, ".", color="0.6", ms=1)

    ax1.axhline(-depth_ppm, color="r", ls=":"); ax1.axvspan(-D_h / 2, D_h / 2, color="r", alpha=0.08)

    ax2.set_title("odd vs even transits"); ax2.set_xlabel("hours")

    star, P, T0, D_h, dep = sys.argv[1], *map(float, sys.argv[2:6])

"""Single-event (mono-transit) box search on the detrended, quality-masked light curve.
Known periodic signals (from work/<star>_signals.json, accepted ones passed on cmd line) are masked."""
import sys, json, numpy as np, pandas as pd
from pipeline import robust_std, fold_phase
def events(star, known=(), thr=7.0):
    d = pd.read_csv(f"work/{star}_lc.csv"); g = d.good.values.copy()
    t, f = d.t.values, d.f.values
    for P, T0, D in known:
        g &= ~(np.abs(fold_phase(t, P, T0)) < D)
    t, f = t[g], f[g]
    out = []
    for Dh in [1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 12]:
        D = Dh / 24
        cs = np.concatenate([[0], np.cumsum(f - 1)])
        centers = np.arange(t.min(), t.max(), D / 4)
        lo = np.searchsorted(t, centers - D / 2); hi = np.searchsorted(t, centers + D / 2)
        n = hi - lo
        expn = D / np.median(np.diff(t))
        ok = n > 0.7 * expn
        mean = np.where(ok, (cs[hi] - cs[lo]) / np.maximum(n, 1), 0)
        sig = robust_std(mean[ok])          # empirical scatter at this timescale (includes red noise)
        snr = -mean / sig
        for i in np.where(ok & (snr > thr))[0]:
            out.append((centers[i], Dh, -mean[i] * 1e6, snr[i]))
    # merge overlapping
    out.sort(key=lambda x: -x[3]); kept = []
    for e in out:
        if all(abs(e[0] - k[0]) > 0.5 for k in kept): kept.append(e)
    return sorted(kept)
if __name__ == "__main__":
    star = sys.argv[1]; known = json.loads(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv) > 2 else []
    for e in events(star, known):
        print(star, "t=%.3f D=%dh depth=%.0f snr=%.1f" % e)

def local_quadratic_trend(t, f, seg, window, step=0.02, user_mask=None):
    """Robust local-quadratic (LOWESS-like) trend: at knots every `step` days fit a
    quadratic to points within +-window/2, iteratively clipping (2.5 sigma upward for
    flares, 3 sigma downward for dips), then interpolate between knots.  Follows
    fast, curved stellar variability much better than a running median."""
    trend = np.full_like(f, np.nan)
    keep_all = np.ones(len(t), bool) if user_mask is None else user_mask.copy()
    for idx in chunks(t, seg):
        tt, ff = t[idx], f[idx]
        keep = keep_all[idx].copy()
        for _ in range(4):
            knots = np.arange(tt.min(), tt.max() + step, step)
            vals = np.full(len(knots), np.nan)
            for k, c in enumerate(knots):
                lo, hi = np.searchsorted(tt, [c - window / 2, c + window / 2])
                m = keep[lo:hi]
                if m.sum() < 10:
                    continue
                x = tt[lo:hi][m] - c
                p = np.polyfit(x, ff[lo:hi][m], 2)
                vals[k] = p[-1]
            ok = np.isfinite(vals)
            tr = np.interp(tt, knots[ok], vals[ok])
            r = ff - tr
            s = robust_std(r[keep])
            keep = keep_all[idx] & (r < 2.5 * s) & (r > -3 * s)
        trend[idx] = tr
    return trend

"""Transit search pipeline: detrend -> quality mask -> iterative BLS -> diagnostics.

Run:  ../.venv/bin/python pipeline.py star_01 [star_02 ...]
"""
import sys, json, os
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from astropy.timeseries import BoxLeastSquares

OUT = os.environ.get("TESS_OUT", "work")

# Detrending window (days) per star; default 0.75 d.  Star 06 is a fast, high-amplitude
# spotted rotator, so it gets a shorter window.
WINDOW = {"star_06": 0.3}

# Time ranges removed by hand after visual inspection (instrumental ramps the
# running median cannot follow).  Everything else is handled automatically.
MANUAL_BAD = {
    "star_03": [(95.3, 97.8), (209.8, 211.8)],
}


def load(star):
    d = pd.read_csv(f"data/{star}.csv")
    d = d[np.isfinite(d.flux) & np.isfinite(d.time_days)]
    return d.sort_values("time_days").reset_index(drop=True)


def chunks(t, seg, gap=0.5):
    brk = np.where((np.diff(t) > gap) | (np.diff(seg) != 0))[0] + 1
    return np.split(np.arange(len(t)), brk)


def robust_std(x):
    x = x[np.isfinite(x)]
    return 1.4826 * np.median(np.abs(x - np.median(x)))


def running_median_trend(t, f, seg, window):
    """Iteratively sigma-clipped running median in a time window, per contiguous chunk.
    Clipping (3 sigma, both sides) keeps transits from dragging the trend down."""
    trend = np.full_like(f, np.nan)
    for idx in chunks(t, seg):
        tt, ff = t[idx], f[idx]
        lo = np.searchsorted(tt, tt - window / 2)
        hi = np.searchsorted(tt, tt + window / 2)
        mask = np.ones(len(tt), bool)
        for _ in range(3):
            tr = np.empty(len(tt))
            for i in range(len(tt)):
                w = ff[lo[i]:hi[i]][mask[lo[i]:hi[i]]]
                tr[i] = np.median(w) if len(w) > 5 else np.median(ff[lo[i]:hi[i]])
            r = ff - tr
            mask = np.abs(r) < 3 * robust_std(r[mask])
        trend[idx] = tr
    return trend


def quality_mask(t, f, seg, star):
    """True = keep.  Removes upward outliers (flares, >4 sigma), time windows where the
    local scatter is > 3x typical (pointing jitter / scattered light), and manual windows."""
    r = f - 1
    sig = robust_std(r)
    good = np.isfinite(f) & (r < 4 * sig)
    # local point-to-point scatter in 0.25-d windows (insensitive to transits)
    loc = np.zeros(len(t))
    for idx in chunks(t, seg):
        tt = t[idx]
        dd = np.abs(np.diff(f[idx], prepend=f[idx][0]))
        lo = np.searchsorted(tt, tt - 0.125); hi = np.searchsorted(tt, tt + 0.125)
        cs = np.concatenate([[0], np.cumsum(dd)])
        loc[idx] = (cs[hi] - cs[lo]) / np.maximum(hi - lo, 1)
        # normalise per chunk (cadence / noise level can differ between segments)
        loc[idx] /= np.median(loc[idx])
    bad = loc > 3
    if bad.any():  # grow bad regions by 0.2 d
        tb = t[bad]
        j = np.searchsorted(tb, t)
        dist = np.minimum(np.abs(t - tb[np.clip(j - 1, 0, len(tb) - 1)]),
                          np.abs(t - tb[np.clip(j, 0, len(tb) - 1)]))
        good &= dist > 0.2
    for a, b in MANUAL_BAD.get(star, []):
        good &= ~((t > a) & (t < b))
    return good


def bin_lc(t, f, width):
    k = np.floor((t - t.min()) / width).astype(np.int64)
    u, inv, cnt = np.unique(k, return_inverse=True, return_counts=True)
    return np.bincount(inv, t) / cnt, np.bincount(inv, f) / cnt, cnt


DURS_H = np.array([0.33, 0.5, 0.75, 1, 1.25, 1.5, 2, 2.5, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 10, 13])


def bls_search(t, f, pmin=0.2, pmax=None, os=3, binw=5 / 1440):
    """BLS over a log-uniform frequency grid fine enough that a 1-h transit drifts by
    <1/os of its duration across the full baseline.  Each duration is searched separately
    and only durations with D <= 0.15 P are allowed at each period."""
    base = t.max() - t.min()
    if pmax is None:
        pmax = min(base / 2.0, 60.0)
    tb, fb, cnt = bin_lc(t, f, binw)
    sig = robust_std(np.diff(f)) / np.sqrt(2)
    eb = sig / np.sqrt(cnt)
    dlnf = (1.0 / 24) / (base * os)
    freqs = np.exp(np.arange(np.log(1 / pmax), np.log(1 / pmin), dlnf))
    periods = np.sort(1 / freqs)
    bls = BoxLeastSquares(tb, fb, eb)
    best = np.full(len(periods), -np.inf)
    arg = dict(t0=np.zeros(len(periods)), dur=np.zeros(len(periods)), depth=np.zeros(len(periods)))
    for dh in DURS_H:
        D = dh / 24
        ok = D <= 0.15 * periods
        if not ok.any():
            continue
        r = bls.power(periods[ok], D, objective="likelihood")
        p = np.sqrt(np.maximum(2 * r.power, 0)) * np.sign(r.depth)  # ~ white-noise SNR
        sel = np.where(ok)[0]
        upd = p > best[sel]
        s2 = sel[upd]
        best[s2] = p[upd]
        arg["t0"][s2] = r.transit_time[upd]
        arg["dur"][s2] = D
        arg["depth"][s2] = r.depth[upd]
    return periods, best, arg


def fold_phase(t, P, T0):
    return (t - T0 + 0.5 * P) % P - 0.5 * P  # days from transit centre


def signal_stats(t, f, P, T0, D, good):
    """Depth, red-noise-aware SNR, odd/even, secondary and per-transit depths."""
    ph = fold_phase(t, P, T0)
    intr = np.abs(ph) < 0.5 * D
    near = np.abs(ph) < 1.0 * D
    oot = good & ~near
    epoch = np.round((t - T0) / P).astype(int)
    sig1 = robust_std(f[oot])

    def dep(m):
        m = m & good
        if m.sum() < 3:
            return np.nan, np.nan
        return 1.0 - np.mean(f[m]), sig1 / np.sqrt(m.sum())
    depth, depth_e = dep(intr)
    # red noise: robust std of out-of-transit flux binned to duration D
    k = np.floor((t[oot] - t[oot].min()) / D).astype(np.int64)
    u, inv, c = np.unique(k, return_inverse=True, return_counts=True)
    fb = np.bincount(inv, f[oot]) / c
    okb = c > 0.6 * np.median(c)
    sigD = robust_std(fb[okb])
    n_in = (intr & good).sum()
    ntr_eff = n_in / np.median(c)
    snr = depth / sigD * np.sqrt(ntr_eff)
    odd, odd_e = dep(intr & (epoch % 2 != 0))
    even, even_e = dep(intr & (epoch % 2 == 0))
    ph2 = fold_phase(t, P, T0 + 0.5 * P)
    sec, sec_e = dep(np.abs(ph2) < 0.5 * D)
    per = {}
    for e in np.unique(epoch[intr & good]):
        m = intr & good & (epoch == e)
        if m.sum() >= 0.5 * np.median(c):
            per[int(e)] = float(1.0 - np.mean(f[m]))
    return dict(depth=depth, depth_e=depth_e, snr=snr, sigD=sigD, n_in=int(n_in),
                ntr=len(per), odd=odd, odd_e=odd_e, even=even, even_e=even_e,
                sec=sec, sec_e=sec_e, per_transit=per)


def refine(t, f, good, P, T0, D):
    """Fine local BLS around the peak for better P, T0, D."""
    tt, ff = t[good], f[good]
    bls = BoxLeastSquares(tt, ff)
    base = tt.max() - tt.min()
    dP = P * D / base
    periods = np.linspace(P - 2 * dP, P + 2 * dP, 201)
    durs = np.unique(np.clip(np.linspace(0.5 * D, 1.6 * D, 23), 0.2 / 24, 0.2 * P))
    r = bls.power(periods, durs, objective="likelihood", oversample=30)
    i = np.argmax(r.power)
    T0 = r.transit_time[i]
    # put T0 near the middle of the data
    n = np.round((np.median(tt) - T0) / r.period[i])
    return r.period[i], T0, r.duration[i]


def run(star, nmax=6, snr_min=7.0, verbose=True):
    d = load(star)
    t, f, seg = d.time_days.values, d.flux.values, d.segment.values
    trend = running_median_trend(t, f, seg, WINDOW.get(star, 0.75))
    fd = f / trend
    good = quality_mask(t, fd, seg, star)
    os.makedirs(OUT, exist_ok=True)
    pd.DataFrame(dict(t=t, f=fd, raw=f, trend=trend, good=good, seg=seg)).to_csv(
        f"{OUT}/{star}_lc.csv", index=False)
    if verbose:
        print(star, "masked %.1f%% of points" % (100 * (1 - good.mean())), flush=True)
    search_mask = good.copy()
    sigs = []
    for it in range(nmax):
        periods, power, arg = bls_search(t[search_mask], fd[search_mask])
        i = np.argmax(power)
        sde = (power[i] - np.median(power)) / np.std(power)
        P, T0, D = periods[i], arg["t0"][i], arg["dur"][i]
        P, T0, D = refine(t, fd, search_mask, P, T0, D)
        st = signal_stats(t, fd, P, T0, D, search_mask)
        rec = dict(iter=it, P=P, T0=T0, D_h=D * 24, sde=sde, peak=power[i], **st)
        if verbose:
            print(star, it, "P=%.5f T0=%.4f D=%.2fh depth=%.0f snr=%.1f sde=%.1f ntr=%d odd=%.0f±%.0f even=%.0f±%.0f sec=%.0f±%.0f" % (
                P, T0, D * 24, st["depth"] * 1e6, st["snr"], sde, st["ntr"], st["odd"] * 1e6, st["odd_e"] * 1e6,
                st["even"] * 1e6, st["even_e"] * 1e6, st["sec"] * 1e6, st["sec_e"] * 1e6), flush=True)
        np.save(f"{OUT}/{star}_pgram{it}.npy", np.vstack([periods, power]))

"""Least-squares trapezoid fit to refine P, T0, depth, total duration and ingress time."""
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
from pipeline import fold_phase, robust_std

def trapezoid(dt, depth, T14, T12):
    """dt in days from centre. Flat bottom of width T14-2*T12, linear ingress/egress."""
    a = np.abs(dt)
    T12 = np.clip(T12, 1e-4, T14 / 2)
    m = np.zeros_like(a)
    flat = a <= T14 / 2 - T12
    m[flat] = depth
    ing = (a > T14 / 2 - T12) & (a < T14 / 2)
    m[ing] = depth * (T14 / 2 - a[ing]) / T12
    return 1 - m

def fit(star, P, T0, D, depth, extra_mask=None, fix_P=False):
    d = pd.read_csv(f"work/{star}_lc.csv")
    g = d.good.values.copy()
    if extra_mask is not None: g &= extra_mask(d.t.values)
    t, f = d.t.values[g], d.f.values[g]
    # put reference epoch near the middle of the data (minimises P-T0 covariance)
    n = np.round((np.median(t) - T0) / P); T0m = T0 + n * P
    win = np.abs(fold_phase(t, P, T0m)) < max(2.5 * D, D + 0.1)
    t, f = t[win], f[win]
    sig = robust_std(f[np.abs(fold_phase(t, P, T0m)) > 0.75 * D])
    def model(p):
        Pp = P if fix_P else p[4]
        return trapezoid(fold_phase(t, Pp, p[0]), p[1], p[2], p[3] * p[2] / 2)
    p0 = [T0m, depth, D, 0.3] + ([] if fix_P else [P])
    lb = [T0m - D / 2, 0, D * 0.3, 0.02] + ([] if fix_P else [P * (1 - 1e-3)])
    ub = [T0m + D / 2, 1, D * 2.5, 1.0] + ([] if fix_P else [P * (1 + 1e-3)])
    r = least_squares(lambda p: (f - model(p)) / sig, p0, bounds=(lb, ub), x_scale="jac")
    J = r.jac; cov = np.linalg.pinv(J.T @ J) * max(1, np.sum(r.fun**2) / (len(f) - len(p0)))
    err = np.sqrt(np.diag(cov))
    out = dict(T0=r.x[0], T0_e=err[0], depth=r.x[1], depth_e=err[1], T14=r.x[2], T14_e=err[2],
               ingress_frac=r.x[3], ingress_frac_e=err[3], P=P if fix_P else r.x[4],
               P_e=0 if fix_P else err[4], chi2r=np.sum(r.fun**2) / (len(f) - len(p0)))
    return out

"""Out-of-eclipse phase-curve harmonics from the RAW flux: per-chunk cubic polynomial
(slow systematics) + cos/sin of 1x and 2x orbital phase fitted simultaneously,
with primary and secondary eclipses masked.  cos(2phi) amplitude = ellipsoidal variation."""
import sys, numpy as np, pandas as pd
from pipeline import chunks, fold_phase
def harmonics(star, P, T0, D):
    d = pd.read_csv(f"work/{star}_lc.csv"); t, f = d.t.values, d.raw.values
    g = d.good.values & (np.abs(fold_phase(t, P, T0)) > 0.75 * D) & (np.abs(fold_phase(t, P, T0 + P / 2)) > 0.75 * D)
    ph = 2 * np.pi * (t - T0) / P
    cols, names = [], []
    for k, idx in enumerate(chunks(t, d.seg.values, gap=0.5)):
        if len(idx) < 100: g[idx] = False; continue
        x = (t - t[idx].mean()) / (np.ptp(t[idx]) + 1e-9)
        for p in range(4):
            c = np.zeros(len(t)); c[idx] = x[idx] ** p; cols.append(c)
    harm = [np.cos(ph), np.sin(ph), np.cos(2 * ph), np.sin(2 * ph)]
    A = np.vstack(cols + harm).T[g]; y = f[g]
    coef, *_ = np.linalg.lstsq(A, y, rcond=None)
    res = y - A @ coef
    cov = np.linalg.pinv(A.T @ A) * np.var(res)
    h = coef[-4:] * 1e6; he = np.sqrt(np.diag(cov))[-4:] * 1e6
    for n, v, e in zip(["cos1 (reflection/phase, -A at transit)", "sin1 (Doppler beaming)", "cos2 (ellipsoidal, negative = minima at conjunctions)", "sin2"], h, he):
        print(f"{star} {n}: {v:.0f} +- {e:.0f} ppm")
    return h, he
if __name__ == "__main__":
    harmonics(sys.argv[1], *map(float, sys.argv[2:5]))
EOF

"""Transit search pipeline: detrend -> quality mask -> iterative BLS -> diagnostics.

Run:  ../.venv/bin/python pipeline.py star_01 [star_02 ...]
"""
import sys, json, os
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from astropy.timeseries import BoxLeastSquares

OUT = os.environ.get("TESS_OUT", "work")

# Detrending window (days) per star; default 0.75 d.  Star 06 is a fast, high-amplitude
# spotted rotator, so it gets a shorter window.
WINDOW = {"star_06": 0.5}
# Star 06 uses a robust local-quadratic trend instead of the running median.
METHOD = {"star_06": "quadratic"}
# Faster (coarser) BLS settings for the stars with multi-year baselines.
SEARCH_KW = {"star_06": dict(os=1.5, binw=10 / 1440, pmax=40.0),
             "star_07": dict(os=1.5, binw=10 / 1440, pmax=40.0)}

# Time ranges removed by hand after visual inspection (instrumental ramps the
# running median cannot follow).  Everything else is handled automatically.
MANUAL_BAD = {
    "star_03": [(95.3, 97.8), (209.8, 211.8)],
    "star_07": [(2520.0, 2523.0)],
}


def load(star):
    d = pd.read_csv(f"data/{star}.csv")
    d = d[np.isfinite(d.flux) & np.isfinite(d.time_days)]
    return d.sort_values("time_days").reset_index(drop=True)


def chunks(t, seg, gap=0.5):
    brk = np.where((np.diff(t) > gap) | (np.diff(seg) != 0))[0] + 1
    return np.split(np.arange(len(t)), brk)


def robust_std(x):
    x = x[np.isfinite(x)]
    return 1.4826 * np.median(np.abs(x - np.median(x)))


def running_median_trend(t, f, seg, window):
    """Iteratively sigma-clipped running median in a time window, per contiguous chunk.
    Clipping (3 sigma, both sides) keeps transits from dragging the trend down."""
    trend = np.full_like(f, np.nan)
    for idx in chunks(t, seg):
        tt, ff = t[idx], f[idx]
        lo = np.searchsorted(tt, tt - window / 2)
        hi = np.searchsorted(tt, tt + window / 2)
        mask = np.ones(len(tt), bool)
        for _ in range(3):
            tr = np.empty(len(tt))
            for i in range(len(tt)):
                w = ff[lo[i]:hi[i]][mask[lo[i]:hi[i]]]
                tr[i] = np.median(w) if len(w) > 5 else np.median(ff[lo[i]:hi[i]])
            r = ff - tr
            mask = np.abs(r) < 3 * robust_std(r[mask])
        trend[idx] = tr
    return trend


def local_quadratic_trend(t, f, seg, window, step=0.02, user_mask=None):
    """Robust local-quadratic (LOWESS-like) trend: at knots every `step` days fit a
    quadratic to points within +-window/2, iteratively clipping (2.5 sigma upward for
    flares, 3 sigma downward for dips), then interpolate between knots.  Follows
    fast, curved stellar variability much better than a running median."""
    trend = np.full_like(f, np.nan)
    keep_all = np.ones(len(t), bool) if user_mask is None else user_mask.copy()
    for idx in chunks(t, seg):
        tt, ff = t[idx], f[idx]
        keep = keep_all[idx].copy()
        for _ in range(4):
            knots = np.arange(tt.min(), tt.max() + step, step)
            vals = np.full(len(knots), np.nan)
            for k, c in enumerate(knots):
                lo, hi = np.searchsorted(tt, [c - window / 2, c + window / 2])
                m = keep[lo:hi]
                if m.sum() < 10:
                    continue
                x = tt[lo:hi][m] - c
                p = np.polyfit(x, ff[lo:hi][m], 2)
                vals[k] = p[-1]
            ok = np.isfinite(vals)
            tr = np.interp(tt, knots[ok], vals[ok])
            r = ff - tr
            s = robust_std(r[keep])
            keep = keep_all[idx] & (r < 2.5 * s) & (r > -3 * s)
        trend[idx] = tr
    return trend


def quality_mask(t, f, seg, star):
    """True = keep.  Removes upward outliers (flares, >4 sigma), time windows where the
    local scatter is > 3x typical (pointing jitter / scattered light), and manual windows."""
    r = f - 1
    sig = robust_std(r)
    good = np.isfinite(f) & (r < 4 * sig)
    # local point-to-point scatter in 0.25-d windows (insensitive to transits)
    loc = np.zeros(len(t))
    for idx in chunks(t, seg):
        tt = t[idx]
        dd = np.abs(np.diff(f[idx], prepend=f[idx][0]))
        lo = np.searchsorted(tt, tt - 0.125); hi = np.searchsorted(tt, tt + 0.125)
        cs = np.concatenate([[0], np.cumsum(dd)])
        loc[idx] = (cs[hi] - cs[lo]) / np.maximum(hi - lo, 1)
        # normalise per chunk (cadence / noise level can differ between segments)
        loc[idx] /= np.median(loc[idx])
    bad = loc > 3
    if bad.any():  # grow bad regions by 0.2 d
        tb = t[bad]
        j = np.searchsorted(tb, t)
        dist = np.minimum(np.abs(t - tb[np.clip(j - 1, 0, len(tb) - 1)]),
                          np.abs(t - tb[np.clip(j, 0, len(tb) - 1)]))
        good &= dist > 0.2
    # chunk edges: drop the first/last 0.1-0.3 d of a chunk if it deviates strongly
    # (ramps / pointing settling at the start or end of an orbit)
    for idx in chunks(t, seg):
        tt, ff = t[idx], f[idx]
        k = np.floor((tt - tt[0]) / 0.1).astype(int)
        u, inv, c = np.unique(k, return_inverse=True, return_counts=True)
        fb = np.bincount(inv, ff) / c
        sb = robust_std(fb)
        for w in (0.1, 0.2, 0.3):
            for side in (tt < tt[0] + w, tt > tt[-1] - w):
                if side.sum() > 3 and abs(np.mean(ff[side]) - np.median(ff)) > 4 * sb * np.sqrt(0.1 / w):
                    good[idx[side]] = False
    for a, b in MANUAL_BAD.get(star, []):
        good &= ~((t > a) & (t < b))
    return good


def bin_lc(t, f, width):
    k = np.floor((t - t.min()) / width).astype(np.int64)
    u, inv, cnt = np.unique(k, return_inverse=True, return_counts=True)
    return np.bincount(inv, t) / cnt, np.bincount(inv, f) / cnt, cnt


DURS_H = np.array([0.33, 0.5, 0.75, 1, 1.25, 1.5, 2, 2.5, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 10, 13])


def bls_search(t, f, pmin=0.2, pmax=None, os=3, binw=5 / 1440):
    """BLS over a log-uniform frequency grid fine enough that a 1-h transit drifts by
    <1/os of its duration across the full baseline.  Each duration is searched separately
    and only durations with D <= 0.15 P are allowed at each period."""
    base = t.max() - t.min()
    if pmax is None:
        pmax = min(base / 2.0, 60.0)
    tb, fb, cnt = bin_lc(t, f, binw)
    sig = robust_std(np.diff(f)) / np.sqrt(2)
    eb = sig / np.sqrt(cnt)
    dlnf = (1.0 / 24) / (base * os)
    freqs = np.exp(np.arange(np.log(1 / pmax), np.log(1 / pmin), dlnf))
    periods = np.sort(1 / freqs)
    bls = BoxLeastSquares(tb, fb, eb)
    best = np.full(len(periods), -np.inf)
    arg = dict(t0=np.zeros(len(periods)), dur=np.zeros(len(periods)), depth=np.zeros(len(periods)))
    for dh in DURS_H:
        D = dh / 24
        ok = D <= 0.15 * periods
        if not ok.any():
            continue
        r = bls.power(periods[ok], D, objective="likelihood")
        p = np.sqrt(np.maximum(2 * r.power, 0)) * np.sign(r.depth)  # ~ white-noise SNR
        sel = np.where(ok)[0]
        upd = p > best[sel]
        s2 = sel[upd]
        best[s2] = p[upd]
        arg["t0"][s2] = r.transit_time[upd]
        arg["dur"][s2] = D
        arg["depth"][s2] = r.depth[upd]
    return periods, best, arg


def fold_phase(t, P, T0):
    return (t - T0 + 0.5 * P) % P - 0.5 * P  # days from transit centre


def signal_stats(t, f, P, T0, D, good):
    """Depth, red-noise-aware SNR, odd/even, secondary and per-transit depths."""
    ph = fold_phase(t, P, T0)
    intr = np.abs(ph) < 0.5 * D
    near = np.abs(ph) < 1.0 * D
    oot = good & ~near
    epoch = np.round((t - T0) / P).astype(int)
    sig1 = robust_std(f[oot])

    def dep(m):
        m = m & good
        if m.sum() < 3:
            return np.nan, np.nan
        return 1.0 - np.mean(f[m]), sig1 / np.sqrt(m.sum())
    depth, depth_e = dep(intr)
    # red noise: robust std of out-of-transit flux binned to duration D
    k = np.floor((t[oot] - t[oot].min()) / D).astype(np.int64)
    u, inv, c = np.unique(k, return_inverse=True, return_counts=True)
    fb = np.bincount(inv, f[oot]) / c
    okb = c > 0.6 * np.median(c)
    sigD = robust_std(fb[okb])
    n_in = (intr & good).sum()
    ntr_eff = n_in / np.median(c)
    snr = depth / sigD * np.sqrt(ntr_eff)
    odd, odd_e = dep(intr & (epoch % 2 != 0))
    even, even_e = dep(intr & (epoch % 2 == 0))
    ph2 = fold_phase(t, P, T0 + 0.5 * P)
    sec, sec_e = dep(np.abs(ph2) < 0.5 * D)
    per = {}
    for e in np.unique(epoch[intr & good]):
        m = intr & good & (epoch == e)
        if m.sum() >= 0.5 * np.median(c):
            per[int(e)] = float(1.0 - np.mean(f[m]))
    return dict(depth=depth, depth_e=depth_e, snr=snr, sigD=sigD, n_in=int(n_in),
                ntr=len(per), odd=odd, odd_e=odd_e, even=even, even_e=even_e,
                sec=sec, sec_e=sec_e, per_transit=per)


def refine(t, f, good, P, T0, D):
    """Fine local BLS around the peak for better P, T0, D."""
    tt, ff = t[good], f[good]
    bls = BoxLeastSquares(tt, ff)
    base = tt.max() - tt.min()
    dP = P * D / base
    periods = np.linspace(P - 2 * dP, P + 2 * dP, 201)
    durs = np.unique(np.clip(np.linspace(0.5 * D, 1.6 * D, 23), 0.2 / 24, 0.2 * P))
    r = bls.power(periods, durs, objective="likelihood", oversample=30)
    i = np.argmax(r.power)
    T0 = r.transit_time[i]
    # put T0 near the middle of the data
    n = np.round((np.median(tt) - T0) / r.period[i])
    return r.period[i], T0, r.duration[i]


def run(star, nmax=5, snr_min=7.0, verbose=True):
    d = load(star)
    t, f, seg = d.time_days.values, d.flux.values, d.segment.values
    if METHOD.get(star) == "quadratic":
        trend = local_quadratic_trend(t, f, seg, WINDOW.get(star, 0.75))
    else:
        trend = running_median_trend(t, f, seg, WINDOW.get(star, 0.75))
    fd = f / trend
    good = quality_mask(t, fd, seg, star)
    os.makedirs(OUT, exist_ok=True)
    pd.DataFrame(dict(t=t, f=fd, raw=f, trend=trend, good=good, seg=seg)).to_csv(
        f"{OUT}/{star}_lc.csv", index=False)
    if verbose:
        print(star, "masked %.1f%% of points" % (100 * (1 - good.mean())), flush=True)
    search_mask = good.copy()
    sigs = []
    for it in range(nmax):
        periods, power, arg = bls_search(t[search_mask], fd[search_mask], **SEARCH_KW.get(star, {}))
        i = np.argmax(power)
        sde = (power[i] - np.median(power)) / np.std(power)
        P, T0, D = periods[i], arg["t0"][i], arg["dur"][i]
        P, T0, D = refine(t, fd, search_mask, P, T0, D)
        st = signal_stats(t, fd, P, T0, D, search_mask)
        rec = dict(iter=it, P=P, T0=T0, D_h=D * 24, sde=sde, peak=power[i], **st)
        if verbose:
            print(star, it, "P=%.5f T0=%.4f D=%.2fh depth=%.0f snr=%.1f sde=%.1f ntr=%d odd=%.0f±%.0f even=%.0f±%.0f sec=%.0f±%.0f" % (
                P, T0, D * 24, st["depth"] * 1e6, st["snr"], sde, st["ntr"], st["odd"] * 1e6, st["odd_e"] * 1e6,
                st["even"] * 1e6, st["even_e"] * 1e6, st["sec"] * 1e6, st["sec_e"] * 1e6), flush=True)
        np.save(f"{OUT}/{star}_pgram{it}.npy", np.vstack([periods, power]))
        sigs.append(rec)
        if st["snr"] < snr_min:
            break
        search_mask &= ~(np.abs(fold_phase(t, P, T0)) < max(1.0 * D, 0.5 * D + 1 / 24))
    json.dump(sigs, open(f"{OUT}/{star}_signals.json", "w"), default=float, indent=1)
    return sigs


if __name__ == "__main__":
    for s in sys.argv[1:]:
        run(s)

"""Final step: take the vetted signal list, re-detrend each star with all its transits
masked, fit a trapezoid to every signal, compute vetting statistics, make one plot per
signal (plots/) and write results.json.

Run after pipeline.py (which writes work/<star>_lc.csv, _signals.json, _pgram*.npy).

import json, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from pipeline import (load, running_median_trend, local_quadratic_trend, quality_mask,
                      fold_phase, robust_std, signal_stats, WINDOW, METHOD)
from fit import fit, trapezoid

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Vetted signal list (initial P, T0, duration[h], depth[ppm] from pipeline.py output;
# all refined below).  pgram = which BLS iteration found it.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
SIGNALS = {
    "star_01": [dict(P=3.69060, T0=2.2036, D=1.15, dep=1630, pgram=0),
                dict(P=7.45086, T0=1.2866, D=0.70, dep=1540, pgram=1),
                dict(P=2.25312, T0=0.9050, D=0.95, dep=560, pgram=2)],
    "star_02": [dict(P=0.46293, T0=0.7257, D=0.47, dep=4100, pgram=0)],
    "star_03": [dict(P=6.26788, T0=0.5022, D=2.85, dep=260, pgram=0)],
    "star_04": [],
    "star_05": [],
    "star_06": [dict(P=8.46319, T0=5.3788, D=3.15, dep=2000, pgram=0)],
    "star_07": [dict(P=14.45, T0=2524.0, D=19.0, dep=0, pgram=None, kind="jitter")],
    "star_08": [dict(P=0.94145, T0=0.4580, D=1.90, dep=10100, pgram=0)],
    "star_09": [dict(P=16.05144, T0=15.0875, D=1.05, dep=2780, pgram=0)],
    "star_10": [dict(P=5.66021, T0=4.5019, D=1.50, dep=3450, pgram=0),
                dict(P=11.38051, T0=4.6762, D=2.00, dep=2560, pgram=1),
                dict(P=3.36013, T0=2.0914, D=1.31, dep=800, pgram=2)],
    # BLS found 1.56689 d; odd/even depths differ hugely -> true period is twice that.
    "star_11": [dict(P=3.13378, T0=0.8510, D=1.00, dep=100000, pgram=0, halfP=True)],
    "star_12": [dict(P=5.65209, T0=1.2284, D=2.50, dep=1220, pgram=0)],
}


def final_lc(star, sigs):
    d = load(star)
    t, f, seg = d.time_days.values, d.flux.values, d.segment.values
    um = np.ones(len(t), bool)
    for s in sigs:
        if s.get("kind") == "jitter":
            continue
        um &= ~(np.abs(fold_phase(t, s["P"], s["T0"])) < 0.75 * s["D"] / 24 + 0.5 / 24)
        if s.get("halfP"):
            um &= ~(np.abs(fold_phase(t, s["P"], s["T0"] + s["P"] / 2)) < 0.75 * s["D"] / 24 + 0.5 / 24)
    if METHOD.get(star) == "quadratic":
        tr = local_quadratic_trend(t, f, seg, WINDOW.get(star, 0.75), user_mask=um)
    else:
        tr = running_median_trend(t, f, seg, WINDOW.get(star, 0.75), user_mask=um)
    fd = f / tr
    good = quality_mask(t, fd, seg, star)
    good |= ~um & np.isfinite(fd) & (fd - 1 < 4 * robust_std(fd[um] - 1))  # never drop in-transit points as "outliers" unless flare-high
    from pipeline import MANUAL_BAD
    for a, b in MANUAL_BAD.get(star, []):
        good &= ~((t > a) & (t < b))
    return t, fd, f, tr, good, seg


def binned(x, y, w):
    if len(x) == 0:
        return np.array([]), np.array([])
    e = np.arange(x.min(), x.max() + w, w)
    k = np.digitize(x, e)
    u = [i for i in np.unique(k) if (k == i).sum() > 2]
    return np.array([x[k == i].mean() for i in u]), np.array([np.mean(y[k == i]) for i in u])


def plot_signal(star, n, t, f, good, seg, fr, st, verdict, reason, pgram, out):
    P, T0, D_h, dep = fr["P"], fr["T0"], fr["T14"] * 24, fr["depth"] * 1e6
    tt, ff = t[good], f[good]
    fig = plt.figure(figsize=(15, 10))
    fig.suptitle(f"{star}  signal {n}:  P = {P:.5f} d   T0 = {T0:.4f}   depth = {dep:.0f} ppm   "
                 f"T14 = {D_h:.2f} h   ->  {verdict.upper()}\n{reason}", fontsize=11)
    ax0 = fig.add_subplot(3, 1, 1)
    if pgram is not None:
        pg = np.load(pgram)
        ax0.plot(pg[0], pg[1], "k-", lw=0.5); ax0.set_xscale("log")
        ax0.axvline(P, color="r", alpha=0.25, lw=4)
        ax0.set_xlabel("period [d]"); ax0.set_ylabel("BLS power (SNR-like)")
        ax0.set_title("BLS periodogram (earlier signals masked); red = this signal", fontsize=9)
    ph = fold_phase(tt, P, T0) * 24
    w = min(max(3 * D_h, 4), P * 24 / 2)
    m = np.abs(ph) < w
    ax1 = fig.add_subplot(3, 3, 4)
    ax1.plot(ph[m], (ff[m] - 1) * 1e6, ".", color="0.7", ms=1)
    xb, yb = binned(ph[m], (ff[m] - 1) * 1e6, max(D_h / 10, 2 / 60))
    ax1.plot(xb, yb, "o", color="C0", ms=3)
    xm = np.linspace(-w, w, 1000)
    ax1.plot(xm, (trapezoid(xm / 24, fr["depth"], fr["T14"], fr["ingress_frac"] * fr["T14"] / 2) - 1) * 1e6, "r-", lw=1.2)
    lim = (-1.6 * dep - 3 * robust_std(yb), 0.6 * dep + 4 * robust_std(yb))
    ax1.set_ylim(*lim); ax1.set_xlabel("hours from mid-transit"); ax1.set_ylabel("flux - 1 [ppm]")
    ax1.set_title("phase-folded (red: trapezoid fit)", fontsize=9)
    ax2 = fig.add_subplot(3, 3, 5)
    ep = np.round((tt - T0) / P).astype(int)
    for par, c, lab in [(0, "C0", "even"), (1, "C3", "odd")]:
        mm = m & (np.abs(ep % 2) == par)
        xb, yb = binned(ph[mm], (ff[mm] - 1) * 1e6, max(D_h / 6, 2 / 60))
        ax2.plot(xb, yb, "o-", color=c, ms=3, lw=0.8,
                 label=f"{lab}: {st[lab] * 1e6:.0f}±{st[lab + '_e'] * 1e6:.0f} ppm")
    ax2.axhline(-dep, color="k", ls=":", lw=0.8); ax2.legend(fontsize=8); ax2.set_ylim(*lim)
    ax2.set_title("odd vs even transits", fontsize=9); ax2.set_xlabel("hours")
    ax3 = fig.add_subplot(3, 3, 6)
    ph2 = fold_phase(tt, P, T0 + P / 2) * 24
    m2 = np.abs(ph2) < w
    ax3.plot(ph2[m2], (ff[m2] - 1) * 1e6, ".", color="0.7", ms=1)
    xb, yb = binned(ph2[m2], (ff[m2] - 1) * 1e6, max(D_h / 6, 2 / 60))
    ax3.plot(xb, yb, "o", color="C2", ms=3)
    ax3.axvspan(-D_h / 2, D_h / 2, color="r", alpha=0.07); ax3.set_ylim(*lim)
    ax3.set_title(f"phase 0.5: secondary = {st['sec'] * 1e6:.0f}±{st['sec_e'] * 1e6:.0f} ppm", fontsize=9)
    ax3.set_xlabel("hours from phase 0.5")
    ax4 = fig.add_subplot(3, 1, 3)
    idx = np.arange(len(t))
    ax4.plot(idx[good], f[good], ".", color="0.55", ms=0.6)
    ax4.plot(idx[~good], f[~good], ".", color="orange", ms=0.6)
    intr = np.abs(fold_phase(t, P, T0)) < fr["T14"] / 2
    ax4.plot(idx[intr & good], f[intr & good], ".", color="r", ms=1.2)
    for b in np.where(np.diff(seg) != 0)[0]:
        ax4.axvline(b, color="k", lw=0.6)
    lo, hi = np.percentile(f[good], [0.05, 99.95])
    ax4.set_ylim(min(lo, 1 - 1.4e-6 * dep), hi)
    ax4.set_xlabel("data point index (black lines = segment boundaries; red = in transit; orange = masked)")
    ax4.set_ylabel("detrended flux")
    plt.tight_layout(rect=(0, 0, 1, 0.94)); plt.savefig(out, dpi=85); plt.close()


def jitter_signal(star, t, fd, raw, good, seg, s):
    """Star 07: periodic bursts of extreme scatter in segment 3.  Locate burst centres from
    the local point-to-point scatter, fit a linear ephemeris, measure mean flux deficit."""
    m = seg == 3
    tt, ff = t[m], raw[m]
    dd = np.abs(np.diff(ff, prepend=ff[0]))
    k = np.floor((tt - tt[0]) / 0.05).astype(int)
    u, inv, c = np.unique(k, return_inverse=True, return_counts=True)
    sc = np.bincount(inv, dd) / c; tb = np.bincount(inv, tt) / c
    hot = sc > 5 * np.median(sc)
    # group hot bins into events
    ev, cur = [], [tb[np.where(hot)[0][0]]]
    for x in tb[hot][1:]:
        if x - cur[-1] < 1.0: cur.append(x)
        else: ev.append(cur); cur = [x]
    ev.append(cur)
    ev = [e for e in ev if len(e) >= 3]
    centres = np.array([0.5 * (min(e) + max(e)) for e in ev])
    widths = np.array([max(e) - min(e) for e in ev])
    n = np.round((centres - centres[0]) / s["P"])
    A = np.vstack([np.ones_like(n), n]).T
    (T0, P), *_ = np.linalg.lstsq(A, centres, rcond=None)
    resid = centres - (T0 + n * P)
    W = np.median(widths) + 0.05
    inwin = np.zeros(len(t), bool)
    for c0 in centres:
        inwin |= np.abs(t - c0) < W / 2
    base = np.median(raw[(seg == 3) & ~inwin])
    deficit = base - np.mean(raw[inwin])
    return dict(P=P, T0=centres[0], T14=W, depth=deficit, centres=centres, resid=resid, widths=widths)


def plot_jitter(star, t, raw, seg, js, reason, out):
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(2, 1, figsize=(15, 8))
    m = seg == 3
    ax[0].plot(t[m], raw[m], "k.", ms=0.7)
    for c0 in js["centres"]:
        ax[0].axvspan(c0 - js["T14"] / 2, c0 + js["T14"] / 2, color="r", alpha=0.15)
    ax[0].set_title(f"{star}: segment 3 raw flux; red = high-scatter episodes (spacing {np.round(np.diff(js['centres']), 2)} d)", fontsize=10)
    ax[0].set_xlabel("time [d]"); ax[0].set_ylabel("raw flux")
    for i, c0 in enumerate(js["centres"]):
        w = np.abs(t - c0) < 1.5
        ax[1].plot(t[w] - c0, raw[w] + 0.25 * i, ".", ms=1.5, label=f"event at {c0:.2f}")
    ax[1].set_xlabel("days from episode centre (offset vertically)"); ax[1].legend(fontsize=8)
    ax[1].set_title("episodes overlaid: chaotic +-10% scatter, not a transit shape", fontsize=10)
    fig.suptitle(f"{star}: P ~ {js['P']:.2f} d  ->  OTHER FALSE POSITIVE\n{reason}", fontsize=11)
    plt.tight_layout(rect=(0, 0, 1, 0.93)); plt.savefig(out, dpi=85); plt.close()


def main():
    import os
    os.makedirs("plots", exist_ok=True)
    results, table = {}, {}
    for star, sigs in SIGNALS.items():
        results[star] = []
        if not sigs:
            continue
        t, fd, raw, tr, good, seg = final_lc(star, sigs)
        pd.DataFrame(dict(t=t, f=fd, raw=raw, trend=tr, good=good, seg=seg)).to_csv(f"work/{star}_final_lc.csv", index=False)
        for n, s in enumerate(sigs, 1):
            if s.get("kind") == "jitter":
                js = jitter_signal(star, t, fd, raw, good, seg, s)
                reason = ("Instrumental: recurring ~0.8-d bursts of +-10% point-to-point scatter (pointing jitter/scattered light) "
                          "only in segment 3, irregular spacing, no transit shape; no transit signal remains once masked")
                plot_jitter(star, t, raw, seg, js, reason, f"plots/{star}_signal{n}_P{js['P']:.2f}d_jitter.png")
                results[star].append(dict(period_days=round(js["P"], 3), t0_days=round(js["T0"], 3),
                                          depth_ppm=round(js["depth"] * 1e6), duration_hours=round(js["T14"] * 24, 1),
                                          verdict="other false positive", reason=reason))
                table[f"{star}#{n}"] = dict(P=js["P"], centres=list(js["centres"]), resid=list(js["resid"]),
                                            widths=list(js["widths"]), depth=js["depth"])
                continue
            fr = fit_star(star, t, fd, good, s)
            st = signal_stats(t, fd, fr["P"], fr["T0"], fr["T14"], good)
            extra = {}
            if s.get("halfP"):
                fr2 = fit_star(star, t, fd, good, dict(P=fr["P"], T0=fr["T0"] + fr["P"] / 2, D=s["D"], dep=0.08), fix_P=True)
                extra["secondary_fit"] = fr2
            if star == "star_08":
                # secondary eclipse: same shape, centred at phase 0.5 (circular orbit), depth free
                extra["secondary_fit"] = fit_star(star, t, fd, good, dict(P=fr["P"], T0=fr["T0"] + fr["P"] / 2, D=fr["T14"] * 24, dep=3e-4), fix_P=True, fix_shape=fr)
            verdict, reason = judge(star, n, fr, st, extra)
            pg = f"work/{star}_pgram{s['pgram']}.npy" if s.get("pgram") is not None else None
            plot_signal(star, n, t, fd, good, seg, fr, st, verdict, reason, pg,
                        f"plots/{star}_signal{n}_P{fr['P']:.4f}d.png")
            results[star].append(dict(period_days=round(fr["P"], 6), t0_days=round(fr["T0"], 5),
                                      depth_ppm=round(fr["depth"] * 1e6, 1), duration_hours=round(fr["T14"] * 24, 3),
                                      verdict=verdict, reason=reason))
            table[f"{star}#{n}"] = dict(fit=fr, stats={k: v for k, v in st.items() if k != "per_transit"},
                                        per_transit_ppm={k: round(v * 1e6) for k, v in st["per_transit"].items()}, **extra)
            print(star, n, verdict, "P=%.6f T0=%.5f depth=%.0f T14=%.2fh snr=%.1f odd=%.0f even=%.0f sec=%.0f±%.0f ingress_frac=%.2f" % (
                fr["P"], fr["T0"], fr["depth"] * 1e6, fr["T14"] * 24, st["snr"], st["odd"] * 1e6, st["even"] * 1e6,
                st["sec"] * 1e6, st["sec_e"] * 1e6, fr["ingress_frac"]), flush=True)
    json.dump(results, open("results.json", "w"), indent=1)
    json.dump(table, open("work/final_table.json", "w"), indent=1, default=float)


def fit_star(star, t, fd, good, s, fix_P=False, fix_shape=None):
    pd.DataFrame(dict(t=t, f=fd, good=good)).to_csv(f"work/_tmp_{star}.csv", index=False)
    if fix_shape is not None:
        # only depth free: linear least squares against the fixed-shape template
        P, T0 = s["P"], s["T0"]
        m = good & (np.abs(fold_phase(t, P, T0)) < 2 * fix_shape["T14"])
        tmpl = 1 - trapezoid(fold_phase(t[m], P, T0), 1.0, fix_shape["T14"], fix_shape["ingress_frac"] * fix_shape["T14"] / 2)
        y = 1 - fd[m]
        A = np.vstack([tmpl, np.ones_like(tmpl)]).T
        coef, *_ = np.linalg.lstsq(A, y, rcond=None)
        res = y - A @ coef
        cov = np.linalg.inv(A.T @ A) * np.var(res)
        return dict(depth=coef[0], depth_e=np.sqrt(cov[0, 0]))
    return fit_lc(t, fd, good, s["P"], s["T0"], s["D"] / 24, s["dep"] / 1e6 if s["dep"] > 1 else s["dep"], fix_P)


def fit_lc(t, f, good, P, T0, D, depth, fix_P):
    import fit as F
    import pandas as _pd
    # reuse fit.fit but on in-memory data
    orig = F.pd.read_csv
    F.pd.read_csv = lambda *a, **k: _pd.DataFrame(dict(t=t, f=f, good=good))
    try:
        return F.fit("mem", P, T0, D, depth, fix_P=fix_P)
    finally:
        F.pd.read_csv = orig


def judge(star, n, fr, st, extra):
    """Verdict logic (thresholds documented in NOTES.md)."""
    dep = fr["depth"] * 1e6
    oe_sig = abs(st["odd"] - st["even"]) / np.hypot(st["odd_e"], st["even_e"])
    sec_sig = st["sec"] / st["sec_e"]
    if star == "star_11":
        s2 = extra["secondary_fit"]
        return ("eclipsing binary",
                f"BLS found P/2=1.567 d but alternate eclipses differ ({fr['depth']*1e2:.1f}% vs {s2['depth']*1e2:.1f}%, "
                f">20 sigma); two unequal ~10% eclipses per 3.134-d orbit = EB")
    if star == "star_08":
        s2 = extra["secondary_fit"]
        return ("planet candidate",
                f"1.05% flat-bottomed transit, odd=even; {s2['depth']*1e6:.0f}+-{s2['depth_e']*1e6:.0f} ppm secondary and "
                f"~180 ppm ellipsoidal/~140 ppm phase curve fit a hot (~2800 K) massive planet, too small for a stellar companion")
    if oe_sig > 3 or sec_sig > 4 or dep > 30000:
        return ("eclipsing binary", f"odd/even {oe_sig:.1f} sigma, secondary {sec_sig:.1f} sigma")
    base = (f"{dep:.0f} ppm, {fr['T14']*24:.2f} h transit seen {st['ntr']}x (SNR {st['snr']:.0f}); "
            f"odd/even agree ({oe_sig:.1f} sigma), no secondary ({sec_sig:.1f} sigma)")
    notes = {
        "star_01": "; one of 3 transiting signals in this star (multi-planet system)",
        "star_02": "; ultra-short period, short duration implies small (M-dwarf) host",
        "star_03": "; shallow, consistent across all 3 segments",
        "star_06": "; on a spotted, flaring young star (transits survive a flare-robust detrend)",
        "star_09": "; only 3 transits, V-ish shape poorly constrained",
        "star_10": "; one of 3 transiting signals (5.66 & 11.38 d near 2:1)",
        "star_12": "; somewhat V-shaped (possibly grazing) but depth too small for an undiluted EB",
    }
    return "planet candidate", base + notes.get(star, "")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
